origin.mms_origins.floran.name: Floran
origin.mms_origins.floran.description: Plant-folk sustained by sunlight and shielded by bark-like skin. They take extra damage from fire and cannot eat meat.
origin.mms_origins.inchling.name: Inchling
origin.mms_origins.inchling.description: Tiny and light-footed, the Inchling can climb walls and tread without triggering mobs. Their small frame takes extra damage from every source.
origin.mms_origins.truffle.name: Truffle
origin.mms_origins.truffle.description: Fungal beings immune to poison. They vent drifting spores to move and strike faster, and acrid spores to poison what they hit, each drawing on a reserve that recovers when unused.
origin.mms_origins.piglin.name: Piglin
origin.mms_origins.piglin.description: Nether natives who trade with their own kind for treasure and strong-arm the brutes for war gear. Gold armor toughens them and fire barely stings, but too long under the overworld sky turns them, and villagers will not deal with a piglin at all.
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.description: Your hide is woody and thick, worth a measure of armor on its own.
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.descrip: Under open sky you tire far more slowly.
power.mms_origins.kindling.name: Kindling
power.mms_origins.kindling.description: You are dry as tinder. Fire hurts you half again as much.
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.name: Verdant Diet
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.descripti: You cannot bring yourself to eat meat.
power.mms_origins.diminutive.name: Diminutive
power.mms_origins.diminutive.description: You are very small, and cannot reach as far as others.
power.mms_origins.light_step.name: Light Step
power.mms_origins.light_step.description: You are far too light to set off anything that listens for footsteps.
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.descript: Everything hurts you half again as much.
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.descript: Toggle to cling to and climb sheer walls.
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.name: Spore Shift
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.descriptio: Toggle acrid spores with [Primary]. While active, your hits poison and spend a spore reserve that recovers out of combat.
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.name: Acrid Spores
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.descript: While active, your attacks deal extra damage and poison the target, spending the spore reserve on each hit.
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.name: Drifting Spores
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.descripti: Toggle drifting spores with [Secondary] to move and attack faster. Sprinting or attacking drains the reserve, which refills once you ease off.
power.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.de: Poison means nothing to a fungus.
power.mms_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.mms_origins.nether_born.descriptio: Born of the Nether, you first open your eyes among its fires and always find your way back to them.
badge.mms_origins.nether_born.0: You spawn in the Nether, and respawn there on death.
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.name: Fire Resilience
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.descri: Flame and lava are the air you grew up in, and they do little to trouble your hide.
badge.mms_origins.fire_resilience.0: You take half damage from fire and lava.
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.name: Sun Shy
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.description: The open sky of the overworld is a strange and tiring place, and standing beneath it wears you down.
badge.mms_origins.sun_shy.0: You lose hunger faster while exposed to the open sky.
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.name: Gilded Bearing
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.descrip: You carry gold as though born to it, and its weight lends your body a real and lasting toughness.
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.name: Kinsmen
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.description: The piglins and their brutes look at you and see one of their own, dealing with you as kin rather than prey.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.0: Piglins and piglin brutes are neutral toward you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.1: Piglins barter more valuable loot for you.
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.name: Arms Dealing
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.descripti: The brutes hoard the bastions and their armories, but for you they will open the vaults and trade their war gear for gold.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.0: Drop a gold ingot or block by a piglin brute to barter for bastion gear.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.1: A brute keeps an ingot 60% of the time; a gold block 30% of the time.
power.mms_origins.zombification.name: Zombification
power.mms_origins.zombification.descript: The overworld sky is poison to your kind; linger beneath it too long and you begin to turn, mind and body slipping away.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.0: Ten minutes in the overworld turns you, in the Nether or out.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.1: While turned, only raw or rotten flesh feeds you and piglins shun you.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.2: Cured by eating golden food, or by death.
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.name: Quarantine Exile
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.descr: A turned piglin is no one's kin, and while the sickness holds you your own people want nothing to do with you.
badge.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.0: While turned you cannot barter, and suffer weakness and hunger.
power.mms_origins.beastly.name: Beastly
power.mms_origins.beastly.description: To a villager you are a monster wandered up from the Nether, not a customer, and they will not deal with your sort.
badge.mms_origins.beastly.0: Villagers refuse to trade unless you wear a carved pumpkin.
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.name: Language Barrier
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.descr: Villagers want nothing to do with your kind, and gouge you on every deal out of spite. Each trade costs you more.
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.name: Cold Blooded
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.descripti: Your body runs on its surroundings. Heat is dangerous to you and burns you half again as much, but cold cannot harm you at all.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.name: Seaborn
power.mms_origins.seaborn.description: You wake in open ocean. Out of the water you can neither rest nor claim a place to wake.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.cant_sleep: You cannot rest out of the water.
power.mms_origins.water_power.name: Water Power
power.mms_origins.water_power.descriptio: Wet, whether submerged or under rain, your blows land far harder. Somewhere hot, or in the Nether, the same tide runs against you.
